title: Execution Query Boundary
description: Explore src/execution/query.rs responsibilities and propose module boundaries for fast paths, projection, ordering, grouping, window, and query orchestration.
findings: Identified column_scan, order, window, aggregate, and orchestration boundaries.

title: Scan Boundary
description: Explore src/execution/scan.rs responsibilities and propose module boundaries for table scan, join execution, index planning, and row fetch helpers.
findings: Identified predicate, index_plan, join, and table scan boundaries.

title: Expression DML DDL Boundary
description: Explore src/execution/expr.rs, dml.rs, ddl.rs and propose low-risk extraction seams and shared helper modules.
findings: Identified expr function/pattern/subquery/value splits plus DDL and DML operation modules.

title: Test Suite Split Strategy
description: Explore tests/sql_integration.rs and propose a test-module split strategy with commands that preserve coverage and reduce per-task merge conflicts.
findings: Identified 12 SQL integration test buckets and a common helper module strategy.

title: Decoupling Plan Generation
description: Consume exploration findings and write a concrete phased decoupling plan with task order, target files, validation commands, and stop conditions.
findings: Generated decoupling-plan.json with 11 tasks across 5 waves.
